scope: scripts/qualify_scenario_arrow.py only; not Rust scientific coverage

rejected_build_record.expected_error: build record must be an object

method: Python -I -m coverage run --branch --include=*/scripts/qualify_scenario_arrow.py QUALIFIER --worker ... from a fresh directory outside the source checkout
Repeat isolated worker with a synthetic non-object build record; require exit 1, explicit failed receipt and no JUnit/test output
coverage combine --keep GUARDS_DATA WORKER_DATA REJECTION_DATA; coverage json
limitations: Branch coverage is measured separately and is 84%, not 90%
No Rust/native algorithm or full repository coverage is inferred
